shadows.name: tile-lift
shadows.purpose: Radar heatmap cells only. Slight physical presence for colored severity tiles.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (button hover, surface tint).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on any screen. One per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; font-family: Geist, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions — open PR, copy, external links.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #f9fafb; color: #171717; font-family: Geist, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f3f4f6; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Severity Badge — Critical
components.description: Severity pill for critical findings. Color + text label always.
components.css: .ds-badge-critical { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #dc2626; color: #fff; font-family: Geist, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Severity Badge — Medium
components.description: Medium severity pill — yellow fill requires dark text for contrast.
components.css: .ds-badge-medium { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #facc15; color: #171717; font-family: Geist, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Recommendation Card
components.description: Container for a single Bob finding with severity, title, detail, and action buttons.
components.html:
criticalMissing resource limits on nginx

Deployment has no CPU or memory limits set. This risks unbounded resource consumption.
components.css: .ds-rec-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Geist, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-rec-card__header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; } .ds-rec-card__title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #171717; } .ds-rec-card__detail { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #4b5563; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; } .ds-rec-card__actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-badge-critical { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #dc2626; color: #fff; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; line-height: 1.4; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; font-family: Geist, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; }

components.name: Terminal / Log Pane
components.description: The scan log stream — the most visually distinctive component. Machine output only.
components.html:
— scan stream: abc123 —
[09:41:22] Analysing deployment: nginx-prod
[09:41:23] CRITICAL: missing resource limits on pod/nginx-prod-7d8f9 (C:1)
[09:41:24] HIGH: unpinned image tag :latest on nginx-prod
components.css: .ds-terminal { background: #030712; border: 1px solid #1f2937; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.5; height: 240px; overflow-y: auto; } .ds-terminal__header { color: #4b5563; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-terminal__line { white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-terminal__line--clean { color: #86efac; } .ds-terminal__line--critical { color: #f87171; } .ds-terminal__line--high { color: #fb923c; } .ds-terminal__line--medium { color: #fbbf24; }

components.description: Sticky top nav with logo and section links.

components.name: Radar Heatmap Cell
components.description: Severity-colored tile showing namespace health at a glance. The product's signature element.
components.css: .ds-heatmap-cell { border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; color: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); font-family: Geist, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-heatmap-cell--critical { background: #dc2626; } .ds-heatmap-cell--high { background: #f97316; } .ds-heatmap-cell--medium { background: #facc15; color: #171717; } .ds-heatmap-cell--low { background: #3b82f6; } .ds-heatmap-cell--clean { background: #22c55e; } .ds-heatmap-cell__name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-heatmap-cell__count { font-size: 0.75rem; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-heatmap-cell__breakdown { display: flex; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
OpsRadar's visual system is built around one question: what would a mission-control display for Kubernetes look like if it didn't compromise on clarity? The Ops Room metaphor demands that every pixel earns its place. Information density is a feature, not a problem to design around. The interface is calm at rest and decisive under pressure — it doesn't shout "critical" through aggressive color; it presents state clearly and lets severity speak through the established scale.

The design takes explicit cues from Vercel's dashboard: dark-capable precision, bold status indicators, a confident absence of decoration. It rejects the ops-tooling defaults — no DataDog navy-gray card grids, no PagerDuty alarm-red atmosphere, no Grafana neon metric lines. This is an intelligence layer, not a metrics viewer.
keyCharacteristics: White canvas with tonal surfaces — no shadows, no texture, no warmth
Command Indigo as the single action voice — used sparingly, never decorative
Severity scale as the product's core language — five values, always consistent
Geist Sans for UI copy, Geist Mono for machine output
Flat elevation: surfaces separate by tint, not shadow

rules.name: The One Command Rule
rules.body: Command Indigo appears on ≤1 primary action per screen. Its job is to say "do this" — use it twice and it no longer means anything.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Severity colors appear only on severity indicators. A red element that isn't a severity badge is a design error.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadow is not a surface separator. Every time a shadow is added to a card or container, ask: can a background tint carry the separation instead? It almost always can.

rules.name: The Mono / Sans Divide
rules.body: Human-authored UI copy is Geist Sans. Machine-produced content (Bob's output, diffs, YAML, log lines) is Geist Mono. The division is semantic, not stylistic.

dos: Do use Command Indigo (#4f46e5) for exactly one primary CTA per screen.
Do pair severity colors with a text label. Color is never the only indicator of severity.
Do use Geist Mono for all machine-produced content: log lines, YAML, diff patches, scan IDs.
Do separate surfaces with background tint (#f9fafb) rather than box-shadow.
Do use border-radius 12px for cards and 8px for buttons.
Do keep body text in Hard Ink (#171717), not Muted Lead.
Do encode dual signals on severity: color AND label AND (where space allows) an icon.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't design for the DataDog / generic SaaS aesthetic: no navy left nav, no gray card grids.
Don't use the PagerDuty alarm-room aesthetic — no heavy red atmosphere.
Don't reference Grafana dark mode visual language outside the terminal pane.
Don't make any screen look like a startup SaaS landing page.
Don't add box-shadow to cards or navigation.
Don't use border-radius above 12px on cards or above 8px on buttons.
Don't use severity colors outside of severity indicators.
Don't mute body content to gray-600 for visual hierarchy — Hard Ink is required for primary reading content.
